dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp, high-contrast pale boundaries are visible along the outer edges of the folded primary and secondary feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Indistinct; the transition from the finely streaked crown to the scalloped mantle is gradual and lacks a sharp linear boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced and repetitive pale scalloping/fringing across all visible dorsal feathers.
